product_one_liner.value: TwelveLabs provides video-native AI models and APIs for developers to search, analyze, and embed video content using natural language.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its video-native foundation models and API platform, explicitly stating that developers use its API to search, analyze, and embed video through natural language: https://www.twelvelabs.io/llms.txt.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page offers plans under the heading 'Start free. Choose a plan as you grow': https://www.twelvelabs.io/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Official customer case studies document SBS’s use of the models and Dyn Sport’s content-creation deployment: https://www.twelvelabs.io/case-studies/sbs and https://www.twelvelabs.io/case-studies/dyn-sport. | named_customers.0: The SBS case study explicitly describes SBS using TwelveLabs models for media reuse and scene-level search: https://www.twelvelabs.io/case-studies/sbs. | named_customers.1: The official Dyn Sport customer case study names the company and its sports-content use case: https://www.twelvelabs.io/case-studies/dyn-sport.

employee_band.notes: The profile reports 173 employees as of November 2, 2026, which falls in the 101-200 band: https://www.tipranks.com/private-companies/twelvelabs. This is a third-party headcount estimate.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: An official job posting explicitly states that TwelveLabs is headquartered in San Francisco: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/twelve-labs/0ec8c8c8-464a-487e-aad5-47b33fc85f22. | hq_country: The company profile identifies San Francisco as headquarters and gives its primary address in the US: https://linkedin.com/company/twelvelabs.

founded_year.notes: The company’s LinkedIn profile explicitly lists its founding year as 2021: https://linkedin.com/company/twelvelabs.

eng_blog.notes: Two engineering posts explain the product’s internal architecture and execution/deployment design: https://www.twelvelabs.io/blog/indexing-3-0-part-1 and https://www.twelvelabs.io/blog/indexing-3-0-part-2. Both list the same four coauthors. Coauthor Paritosh Mohan identifies himself as VP of Engineering at https://www.twelvelabs.io/blog/why-i-joined-twelvelabs. These are implementation accounts, not merely product announcements or customer tutorials.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation includes quickstart guides, comprehensive guides, an API reference, and SDK documentation, rather than a single FAQ: http://docs.twelvelabs.io/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live posting titled 'Staff ML Research Engineer, Multimodal Structure & Marengo' includes an application link and directly qualifies as an ML opening: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/twelve-labs/0869a12a-5beb-4f36-bda6-36cdb32931b4.

model_provider.value: TwelveLabs’ proprietary Marengo and Pegasus models
model_provider.notes: The public documentation identifies TwelveLabs’ own Marengo embedding model and Pegasus generative model and explains their respective uses: http://docs.twelvelabs.io/.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The official trust center lists SOC 2 Type II reports, including a 2026 report. SOC 2 is the certification named in the cited compliance section: https://trust.twelvelabs.io/. | compliance_certs.0: The official trust center names SOC 2 Type II reports: https://trust.twelvelabs.io/.

Thus the requested month is 2026-07: https://pitchbook.com:8443/profiles/company/439422-85 and https://www.twelvelabs.io/blog/twelvelabs-series-b-100m. | funding_amount_usd: The latest-round record identifies a $100 million Series B on July 1, 2026, corroborated by PitchBook’s round listing: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/6058c9f8c2f6111eb227e327/twelve%20labs#a:about and https://pitchbook.com:8443/profiles/company/439422-85.

raised_18mo.notes: The company’s $100 million funding announcement is dated July 1, 2026, matching the recorded Series B date and falling within the 18 months before November 9, 2026: https://www.twelvelabs.io/blog/twelvelabs-series-b-100m and https://pitchbook.com:8443/profiles/company/439422-85.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Sales Development Representative, Emerging Verticals posting explicitly describes the SDR role: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/twelve-labs/4c347677-cb97-481f-b8d2-41c8d999040e.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced the release of Pegasus 1.6 on October 6, 2026, adding capabilities for understanding complex real-world environments. This falls within the six months before November 9, 2026: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/10/06/3375633/0/en/twelvelabs-brings-video-understanding-to-physical-ai-with-latest-launch.html.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown. The official About page presents advisors rather than a complete executive roster: https://www.twelvelabs.io/about-us. The identified VP Engineering joining announcement predates the requested window: https://www.twelvelabs.io/blog/why-i-joined-twelvelabs. No qualifying within-window appointment or departure was verified, and the available roster is insufficient to support false.
